messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: [PROBE_FAIL] canary-prober eu-west-1 — 12% probe failures in last 5m. Pager: https://pagerduty.example/INC-8023

pagerduty: Incident INC-8023 created, severity: S2, service: synthetic-canary

maya: ack - I'm on it. checking the canary dashboard now :eyes:

samir: seeing rising 5xx for inference-euw-1-proxy around the same timestamp, maybe upstream auth or rate-limit. grab logs now

trent: quick mitigation idea — reduce canary fanout to 1 region to stop noise and see if probe failures stabilize. command in console:
```
rcp canary update --name synthetic-canary --fanout 1 --regions eu-west-1
```

maya: doing a soft rollback to previous probe binary SHA. running:
```
kubectl -n infra set image deploy/canary-runner canary=registry/redwood/canary:20260211-7
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-8023 acknowledged by maya at 4023456840

maya: rolling back now, if it doesn't help I'll throttle outbound calls to external auth

samir: pulled logs — auth service is returning 503 from a particular upstream cluster (auth-eu-b). putting temp route to fallback-auth

trent: applying fallback route on the infra loadbalancer:
```
curl -X POST https://infra-api/route -d '{"service":"auth","target":"fallback-auth","ttl":300}'
```

olivia: @maya @samir i'm next on-call in 20m, please DM me a quick summary before handoff :handshake:

maya: TL;DR: canary failures started 10:14 UTC, 12% failure rate, rollback in progress, applied auth fallback. No customer-facing errors observed yet, small uptick in 500s for eu-west inference paths. continuing monitoring.

incident-bot: Synth-monitor: failure rate down to 6% over last 2m, still above threshold. Recheck in 5m. :bar_chart:

maya: good sign. I'm going to keep the rollback and fallback for 30m then re-evaluate. tagging this thread for on-call handoff to @olivia

olivia: got it. thanks for the summary. will take over monitoring in 15m and coordinate with infra to validate fallback TTL and postmortem items

trent: note to postmortem — consider adding per-probe upstream validation and earlier auth fallback circuit to avoid noisy pages

pagerduty: INC-8023 status update: monitoring; last event 4023458900

samir: capturing log snippets and the failing upstream trace into the incident doc (link: https://confluence.redwood/INC-8023)

maya: leaving for handoff in 10m — @olivia you're on

olivia: acknowledged. switching notification to my phone. if anything changes call PD. :phone:
